races.title: State Senate, District 8
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Angelique Ashby
cands.bio: Democrat representing California Senate District 8 since December 2022 and named Senate Majority Leader in December 2025. Sacramento City Council member for District 1 from 2010 to 2022. Attorney and managing partner of Ashby Consulting Group, which designs social programs for parolees and foster youth.

controversies.text: In August 2022, Ashby's opponent Dave Jones sued over her ballot title "Councilmember/Women's Advocate." A judge ruled she hadn't shown it was a primary vocation distinct from her council work. She called the challenge petty and the ruling disappointing. She ran as "City Councilwoman," and the Secretary of State's office had accepted her designation.

endorsements.text: 2026 endorsements listed by Ballotpedia include the Democratic Party of California, the California Federation of Labor Unions (AFL-CIO), IUOE Local 3, the National Union of Healthcare Workers, and Equality California.
In 2022 she was endorsed by then-Sen. Richard Pan, Gov. Gavin Newsom, former Gov. Jerry Brown and EMILY's List.

cands.gaps: We found no documented positions or actions on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, slowing growth, H-1B or immigration enforcement, gun laws, school choice or teacher pay, or police pay and pensions. We found no statements on pledges to refuse particular kinds of donations. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. Her campaign issues page was only partly readable, and the text we saw looked like it dates from her earlier Senate campaign. A Ballotpedia note that she authored a bill requiring local governments to create streamlined homelessness responses has no bill number or details, so we left it out.

local.label: Roots 80: Born in Ashland, Oregon, she moved to the Sacramento area as a child, attended school in Roseville and Sacramento, and has lived in Sacramento since.

qual.background: Twelve years on the Sacramento City Council (including vice mayor/mayor pro tem), State Senator since 2022, nominated Senate Majority Leader in December 2025; J.D. holder and managing partner of a consulting firm.
qual.why: Long legislative service at city and state level, chamber leadership as Majority Leader, a law degree and experience running a business place her in the high range for writing law and budgets.

cands.name: Susan A Mason
cands.bio: Republican candidate for California State Senate District 8 in 2026. She also appeared as a write-in candidate for the same seat in 2022. No occupation or offices held could be verified from the sources available.

endorsements.text: Ballotpedia lists these endorsements and voter guide recommendations for her 2026 campaign: Reform California, The Morning Answer with Jennifer Horn, April's Common Sense Cali Voters, Based in Malibu, and Elizabeth Barcohana's Lady with a Brain Voter Guide.

cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Susan Mason was born or raised, when she came to California, or what she has done for work. She holds no known elected office. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, so we found no stated positions on issues like data centers, property taxes, housing, immigration, guns, abortion, schools, or policing. We also found no documented actions, controversies, or foreign ties.
